train_StyleGAN2_cond_unet: train a StyleGAN2 conditional UNet model for part-based doodle image generation from JSON sketch data
create_Dataset_JSON: create a JSON-based PyTorch dataset that loads and rasterizes vector sketch parts with random affine augmentations
generate_truncated_DoodlerGAN: generate truncated latent samples using the DoodlerGAN model to produce completed doodle parts from partial sketches
evaluate_DoodlerGAN: evaluate the trained DoodlerGAN model and save generated part images as PNG tiles to the results directory
build_Encoder_unet: build a U-Net encoder that extracts multi-scale feature maps from multi-channel partial sketch input images
